question: Can the STATE v2 predictor BUY usable accuracy by abstaining (selective prediction), and how well is it calibrated? Which feature group actually carries the value (ablation), and does it survive a permutation null?
target: STATE_V2(t+8), STATE_V2 = frozen MARKET_BEHAVIOR with min-dwell k=2

protocol.blind_split: single 60/40 split; fit once on first 60%, evaluate once on last 40%
protocol.selective: sort blind-test predictions by max posterior; report accuracy and DeltaLL at coverage 100/80/60/40/20%
protocol.calibration: 10-bin expected calibration error (ECE) on the blind test

ablation_ladder.A2_PLUS_STATE_HISTORY: A2 + one-hot(current state) + dwell length + rolling NO_DEFINED rate(8)

protocol.null: block-shuffle (block=48) of the target, full protocol re-run, NPERM=30, empirical p
protocol.acceptance: SELECTIVE_VALUE if accuracy at 40% coverage exceeds full-coverage accuracy by >= 0.10 absolute; ABLATION_DECIDED by largest positive incremental DeltaLL vs A2_STRUCT
